instruction: Add stars to all messages in the Sent folder

rules.sql: select (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 10) = count(distinct messageID) from messageAttributes where attributeID = 58 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 10);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding stars to all emails in the Sent folder (folderID=10). The evaluator checks if at least one message has the 'star' attribute (attributeID=58) set to 1 in the Sent folder. Verified from database: Sent folder (folderID=10) contains 2 emails, attributeID 58 corresponds to 'star' status.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies ALL messages are starred: SQL compares total message count (left side) with starred message count (right side) using equality operator
Complete coverage: The query returns 1 only when count of all messages in Sent folder equals count of starred messages, ensuring every message has a star

Correct SQL logic: 'select (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 10) = count(distinct messageID) from messageAttributes where attributeID = 58 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 10)' uses '=' comparison, not '>0' check
Appropriate postconfig: Closes Thunderbird window before reading database to ensure consistent state
Data accessibility: SQLite database is accessible after application closure, getter correctly retrieves file from VM

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric run_sqlite3 first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
